## 主张 Claim

跨情境读出：对每类记录与意义，在不重复的候选范围中，形式解析为某意义，恰当每个关涉该形式的记录都提供它，且其他每个意义都缺于某个关涉的记录。对行动形成的场景：从每个转移记录对二词编码成组、候选范围不重复的处境出发，经每段移动与命名的历史，每个有限编码序列的解释是其原子的组合，恰当对每个词，先前记录与沿途所闻的命名（各提供学习者所在处可及者）分离其原子。协调的历史（coordinated 37）是实例；在一处命名（stationary 37）缺分离，从原子不可及处命名（mistimed 37）缺覆盖。指定空间关系与有支持的移动／命名史产生已有绑定构造的精确解释输入；另外有实际响应及访问、保留、时序失败见证。 / Cross-situational resolution: for every type of records and meanings, a form resolves to a meaning of a repertoire without repeats exactly when every record bearing on the form offers it and every other meaning is missing from some bearing record. For enacted scenes: from every situation whose transition record groups the two-word encoding and whose repertoire has no repeats, after every history of moves and namings, every finite encoded sequence is interpreted as the assembly of its atoms exactly when, for each word, the earlier records and the namings heard along the history, each offering what was accessible where the learner stood, separate its atom. The coordinated history (coordinated 37) is an instance; naming from one place (stationary 37) fails separation, and naming a site from where its atom is not accessible (mistimed 37) fails coverage. The specified spatial arrangement and supported movement/naming history produce the previous binding construction’s exact interpretation inputs; separate witnesses cover actual response and access, retention and timing failures.

Canonical source: [EnactedScene.lean](../../../../experiments/integrated-correction/general-framework/generative-basis/lean/inquiry-root/EnactedScene.lean)

## 前提与对应 Hypotheses and correspondence

- 给定整数二维位置、Manhattan 距离与范围2、三个已识别操作位置、移动规律、命名约定和安排。 / Integer two-dimensional positions, Manhattan distance and range two, three identified operation sites, movement law, naming convention and schedule are supplied.
- 复用已取得分节与绑定架构；成功史有37单位声明支持，移动消耗5单位。 / The acquired grouping/binding architecture is reused; the successful history has 37 declared support units, including five consumed by movement.

接收位置与被命名位置是同一局部安排的关系角色。范围表示可取得性，未独自解释完整视野、注意、身体或沟通意图。 / Receiving and named positions are relational roles within one local arrangement. Range represents accessibility; it does not itself explain a full visual field, attention, bodies or communicative intention.
